svg.title: Following a healthcare worker across borders
svg.desc: At the destination: A nurse can fill a vacancy and receive further training.. At home: The clinic that trained the nurse may lose a colleague.. Across borders: Rights, training and earnings can change the balance.

g.text: Following a healthcare worker across borders
A nurse can fill a vacancy and receive further training.
The clinic that trained the nurse may lose a colleague.
Rights, training and earnings can change the balance.
